title: Distinct Spatial Organisation of Rho and RNA Polymerase in Salmonella Cells.
authors: Bossi, Lionello; Le Bars, Romain; Black, Johnathan C; Buggiani, Julia; Clerte, Caroline; Do, Thuy Duong; Margeat, Emmanuel; Boudvillain, Marc; Figueroa-Bossi, Nara
one_liner_zh: 该文用荧光显微成像研究沙门氏菌中Rho因子与RNA聚合酶的空间分布，虽涉及转录相关蛋白，但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题核心无关。
abstract: Rho is a conserved, ATP-dependent RNA translocase that terminates transcription at hundreds of sites across bacterial genomes. Although the molecular mechanism of Rho-dependent termination is well characterized, its spatial interplay with RNA polymerase (RNAP) within bacterial cells remains elusive. To address this question, we constructed intragenic, in-frame fusions inserting mCherry or sfGFP 48 amino acid residues downstream of the N-terminus of Rho in Salmonella. Strikingly, mCherry-but not sfGFP-renders the first 48 residues of Rho dispensable. RhoDelta48::mCherry is viable in single copy and exhibits wild-type termination activity in vitro, whereas the full-length Rho::sfGFP fusion, although viable, slows growth and shows strongly reduced activity. Structured illumination microscopy (SIM) revealed that, despite these functional differences, both constructs exhibit similar localisation patterns relative to fluorescently tagged RNAP in single cells. During exponential growth, both Rho and RNAP form discrete clusters, but with markedly distinct spatial organisations: RNAP clusters associate with the nucleoid, whereas Rho is distributed throughout the cell body. This spatial partitioning persists in stationary phase, where RNAP becomes diffusely associated with a compacted nucleoid while Rho accumulates at the cell periphery. The widespread distribution of Rho at cytoplasmic locations is unexpected and suggests participation in cellular functions beyond its canonical role in transcription termination.
abstract_zh: Rho是一种保守的、依赖ATP的RNA转位酶，在细菌基因组的数百个位点终止转录。尽管Rho依赖性终止的分子机制已被充分表征，但其在细菌细胞内与RNA聚合酶（RNAP）的空间相互作用仍难以捉摸。为解决此问题，我们在沙门氏菌中构建了基因内、框内融合，将mCherry或sfGFP插入Rho N端下游48个氨基酸残基处。引人注目的是，mCherry——而非sfGFP——使Rho的前48个残基变得可有可无。RhoDelta48::mCherry在单拷贝下可存活，并在体外表现出野生型终止活性，而全长Rho::sfGFP融合虽可存活，但减缓生长并显示显著降低的活性。结构化照明显微镜（SIM）揭示，尽管存在这些功能差异，两种构建体在单细胞中相对于荧光标记的RNAP表现出相似的定位模式。在指数生长期，Rho和RNAP均形成离散簇，但空间组织显著不同：RNAP簇与拟核关联，而Rho分布在整个细胞体内。这种空间分区在稳定期持续存在，此时RNAP变得弥散地关联于压缩的拟核，而Rho则积累在细胞外周。Rho在细胞质位置的广泛分布出乎意料，并提示其参与超越经典转录终止功能的细胞功能。
